responsibility: Exports the user-facing PowerPC AltiVec intrinsic interface header. It checks that vector support is enabled, defines the vector/pixel/bool keywords when needed, supplies the standard AltiVec API names and compatibility aliases, and maps them onto GCC backend builtins and predicate helpers so C and C++ source can express AltiVec operations using the documented intrinsic vocabulary.
same_name_distinction: This is the public AltiVec intrinsic header for source programs, defining vector/pixel/bool aliases and mapping API names to builtins. Unlike altivec.md, it is a front-end include interface rather than backend RTL instruction patterns.
